market_question: Will Marco Rubio win the 2028 US Presidential Election?
reasoning: Marco Rubio faces a wide-open 2028 GOP primary where many stronger candidates (DeSantis, Haley, Youngkin) are likely to run. He has a limited national following and struggled in 2016. Even if he secures the nomination, Democrats will have a massive electoral base. Given the distance to the election, a 7% true probability is generous.
evidence_points: Rubio's 2016 campaign peaked briefly and then fizzled, showing limited national appeal.
A crowded GOP primary with higher-profile contenders will hurt his path to the nomination.
The 2028 election landscape is too uncertain, and generic Republican odds are not all assigned to a single candidate like Rubio.
sources_consulted: Implied odds from prediction markets for similar wide-open races
